title: fix: resolve build errors in plugin-report, layout, plugin-form, plugin-grid
body:
Multiple packages fail `tsc` during build due to unresolvable module imports (`@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/react`, `@storybook-config/datasource`) and implicit `any[]` in test mocks.

### `plugin-report` — wrong dependency classification

`@object-ui/*` workspace packages were in `peerDependencies`, so turbo didn't order their builds upstream. Every other plugin (dashboard, detail, kanban, etc.) correctly uses `dependencies`. Moved them accordingly.

```diff
-  "peerDependencies": {
+  "dependencies": {
     "@object-ui/components": "workspace:*",
     "@object-ui/core": "workspace:*",
     ...
```

### `layout`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid` — missing tsconfig excludes

These three packages lacked the standard `exclude` pattern that 20+ other packages already use. Stories import `@storybook-config/datasource` (alias only in Storybook's Vite config) and tests have strict-mode type issues — both irrelevant to the build output.

```json
"exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.test.tsx", "**/*.stories.tsx"]
```
